title: A Autopsy for the Portrait
author: Lena Sandoval
blurb: Yara Okonkwo, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
